description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Four pivoting arms provide space to hang and separate towels, helping you maximize bathroom space.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent floor scratching
- Part of the Soho collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
